answer: The zenith holds work receipts rather than names, so the forge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing.
